notes.title: Patch notes v1.1
notes.notes:
Found some issues post launch that players were experiencing and have fixed the following:

[list]
[*] Player getup animation after ragdoll was making him clip through floor. This has now been fixed.
[*] Save data was not being read properly for docks level which is now working properly.
[*] Minor Objective issue and reward fixes.
[*] Additional info for Homing weapons added.
[/list]

notes.title: Cyber Seekers Demo Update for Next Fest
notes.notes:
The demo for Cyber Seekers Conquest is out now. Use your traversal abilities to explore the docks level and participate in multiple challenges. Find weapons with unique traits in crates placed at various places and use them to deal with rogue bots.

[previewyoutube=3CT1jJ49tjU;full][/previewyoutube]

In this Rogue Lite Shooter, each bot that you destroy will raise the alert level. As it increases, you will get access to high-level weapons with additional traits. Be aware, though, that you will face more powerful bots at high levels. If your bot gets destroyed, you will lose your current weapons and restart the level with a new one.

Interact with terminals to gain powerful upgrades or start a challenge. Terminals host random challenges on each run. 

Terminal Types are described below.
[list]
[*] [b]Credits Store:[/b] Sells upgrades in exchange for credits. These items are lost when your bot gets destroyed.
[*] [b]Schematics Store:[/b] Install permanent upgrades in exchange for schematics. These are automatically installed in a new bot in subsequent runs.
[*] [b]Survival Challenge:[/b] Face waves of bots while uploading a program in the terminal. You will be rewarded adequately.
[*] [b]Race Challenge:[/b] Get rewards for going through each checkpoint as quickly as you can.
[*] [b]Program:[/b] These give you a stat boost but reduce another stat.
[/list]

The demo also includes a simulation level that will guide you through the basics. So what are you waiting for? Jump right in and experience dynamic wall running in a Sci-fi Rogue Lite.

I would love to hear about your experience. If you have any general feedback, use the feedback link in the game menu to fill out a form.

Happy Gaming!

notes.title: Demo patch notes v1.2
notes.notes:
With recent playtests, players were facing issues with the tutorial level at the point where the player had to eject from the wall to complete the sequence. This sequence has been removed and replaced with another sequence.

[h1]Fixes: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Schematics were not removed when an upgrade was purchased. 
[*] Reduced background music volume in tutorial level.
[*] Cosmetic changes to buttons in menus.
[*] If the bot touches the water while grappling, it no longer destroys the bot.
[*] Improved aiming and shooting in general. Resolved the issue of shooting far-off enemies inaccurately.
[*] Camera rotation when starting wall run interrupted player input for a cinematic camera; this has been changed, and the interruption no longer happens.
[/list]

[h1]Enhancements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Input icons have been added for grapple and Telekinetic Grab to make it easier for the player to perform the required actions.
[*] Traversal challenge timers have been increased for some challenges.
[*] Bots now randomly spawn ammo cores when they are shot with bullets.
[*] Increased bullet capacity of rifles.
[*] Traversal challenge checkpoint trigger size has been increased.
[*] Two new sequences were added to the tutorial. Information about alert levels is also given in the tutorial.
[/list]
